title: adaptive_checkout_psd2_approved
description: Approved Decide Response with PSD2 recommendation

id.description:
Unique ID of order being acted upon. 

 Note: This value should be later reflected also as order.id on the subsequent calls

status.description:
Textual status describing the result of Riskified analysis. 

 Always 'approve' for approved orders. Order is approved and guaranteed by Riskified

recommendations.description: An array of recommendation types and values.

recommendation.description:
Textual status describing the PSD2 recommendation.

 Possible values are: 
 - `sca` - requesting exemption not recommended
 - `tra` - order is recommended and should be liable for exemption request
 - `low_value` - the order qualifies for the Low Value Transaction (LVT) exemption
 - `out_of_scope` - the order is out of scope for PSD2
